headline: Recommended City Council approve equipment sale, easement, contracts, and staff reclassifications; approved sidepath contract amendment and meeting schedule.
summary: The board adopted a consent agenda approving the July 13, 2026 minutes and a meeting schedule through February 8, 2027, and recommending City Council approve a $17,500 SCBA equipment sale and a utility easement with Green Mountain Power. The board also recommended City Council approve several staff reclassifications, a $339,262 garage repair contract, a five-year parking-fine donation program, and a drinking water personnel reorganization. Separately, the board approved a $33,681 contract amendment for the Queen City Park Road Sidepath design.
decisions: Approved the July 13, 2026 Board of Finance meeting minutes as part of the consent agenda.
Approved the regular schedule of Board of Finance meetings from September 14, 2026 to February 8, 2027.
Recommended City Council approve the sale of 10 SCBA units to the Hampton Volunteer Fire Company, Inc. for $17,500.
Recommended City Council grant an electrical utility easement to Green Mountain Power on Eagle Drive in South Burlington, Vermont.
Recommended City Council approve reclassifying a Data, Communications and Operations Specialist position from Grade 14 to Grade 15.
Recommended City Council authorize a $339,262 contract with Structural Preservation Systems, plus $50,000 contingency, for Westlake Garage and College Street Garage repairs, not to exceed $389,262.
Recommended City Council authorize a five-year charitable donation program to Feeding Champlain Valley using delinquent parking fine revenue, 2026 through 2030.
Recommended City Council approve reclassifying one Right of Way Working Foreperson position to a Right of Way Operations Lead position.
Approved a contract amendment with Hoyle Tanner & Associates, Inc. increasing the Queen City Park Road Sidepath design contract by $33,681 plus $10,000 contingency, for a new total of $257,926.
Recommended City Council approve the Water Resources drinking water personnel reorganization, including the Distribution Operations Lead and Water Treatment Plant workgroup tiering.
